messages.text: I’ll read the prepared mandate and pinned sources, then assess the comparison method, calibration separation and fit-selection accounting.

The proposed comparison can support a conditional fit-resolution result if each baseline uses its own frozen, independently trained error table. I found that the shared reader skips its calibration audit for these report schemas; the coordinator confirms the new reducer explicitly runs that audit and the source/geometry checks for every case.

**FATRASBASE-PhysVal-01: no methodological blocker to continuing the native campaign.** Delivery remains conditional on the final source/data review.

Reviewed assignment revision **379901aec076ee3c2c2952439303771d6a7c65d1**, including all seven named inputs, and separately inspected the committed execution runner/recipe at **326fed57a3c3aa75466756f47cee2e69d5d22b9b**. The assigned inputs are unchanged between those revisions.

The method is suitable for a qualified whole-baseline comparison:

- Each baseline receives its actual response and matching calibration: old 0.5 mm short strips with the frozen, identity-checked training; current 2 mm strips with independent 50k training. Measurement-only calibration avoids fitted-pull tuning.
- The maintained observables correctly use origin-perigee truth, wrapped phi and full theta–q/p covariance for derived pT uncertainty.
- Generated-event pairing can support ratio uncertainties despite differing selection outcomes, provided bootstrap indices are shared across both baselines before each sample independently removes unavailable residuals.

One concrete integration hazard requires a retained final gate: [the shared reader]([redacted] recognizes new studies through `variant`, while these reports use `baseline`. Thus it skips its automatic new-study calibration checks. The coordinator confirms the new reducer explicitly validates source/geometry contracts and calls `audit_calibration(..., "geometric")` for every case. Verify that implementation at the final pinned revision; no native rerun is indicated by this issue.

Minimum final controls:

- Generated, selected, attempted, returned-fit and finite-parameter counts per bin; native-unmatched, invalid covariance and wrong-charge counts retained separately. Covariance validity must gate pulls, while finite residuals remain.
- All observed measurement variances checked against the appropriate frozen table, with training group counts, overflow treatment and unsupported groups exposed.
- All-finite-fit width68 ratios primary; common-survivor ratios diagnostic. Retain undefined bootstrap replicate counts and minimum-30 masking. Intervals are pointwise and conditional on fixed calibration/maps.
- Bias, full SD/RMS, tails and charge errors accompany core widths, especially for nonlinear forward high-pT residuals. Time remains an unmeasured prior diagnostic.
- Interpret differences as combined geometry/material/response changes. Map locality, one-phi-bin averaging and ideal truth seeds preclude isolated service/pitch or pattern-recognition claims.

Actual work was read-only source and contract inspection. No tests, native imports, simulations or edits were performed. Reported campaign successes and old-reference reproduction remain coordinator evidence pending independent final checks; no human acceptance is implied.
